usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover the top-level API sub-resources available under a specific node (e.g., qemu, lxc, storage, network, tasks). It acts as an index and is commonly called first to confirm a node name is valid and reachable before issuing node-scoped operations. No special privilege is required beyond being authenticated; any user can call this.
tips: The response is an array of objects with a 'name' field representing child resource names (e.g., 'qemu', 'lxc', 'storage') — use these as path segments for deeper node-scoped calls.
Node names must match the pve-node format exactly (lowercase, no spaces); the cluster node list from get_cluster_config_nodes or get_nodes can supply valid names.
If the node is offline or unreachable, the API may return an error or an empty index rather than a clean 404 — check cluster status first if results are unexpected.
